g.text: Speed and current control (rotor-flux oriented, indirect)

div.strong: Indirect rotor-field-oriented control (IFOC) of an induction motor

ul.li: Speed PI gives iq, a flux reference gives id (pre-flux 12 A for 80 ms, then 5.5 A).
Slip speed wsl = Rr/Lr * iq*/id*, electrical flux speed we = p*w + wsl (w from the motor in rpm, converted inside the function block), thetae = integral of w_e.
Phase currents (1 V/A from the motor) go through Clarke and Park(theta_e) to id/iq, two PI current controllers give vd/vq.
Inverse Park, space vector modulation and three PWM generators drive the half bridges (600 V bus).
Speed reference steps to 950 rpm at 0.1 s, a 15 N*m load torque is applied at 0.35 s.
Wires are net labels: equal names are one node.
Motor outputs: W in rpm, TH in degrees.
